Telecom Software Quality Assurance Automation 
 Who we are? 
 A major player for 20 years in the critical communications market, STREAMWIDE has successfully developed its Team on mission (mission critical) and Team on the run (business critical) software solutions for administrations and businesses. These solutions for smartphones and PCs, offered in a SaaS model or on Premise, benefit from numerous functionalities such as the multimedia group discussions, VoIP, push-to-talk (MCPTT and MCx new generation 4G / 5G LTE), geolocation, digitization, and automation of business processes. These innovative solutions meet the growing needs for digital transformation and real-time coordination of interventions. They allow field teams to transform individual contributions into collective successes and to act as one in the most demanding professional environments.
 STREAMWIDE is also present on the Value-Added Services software market for telecom operators (visual voice messaging, billing, and charging of calls in real time, interactive voice servers, applications and announcements) with more than 130 million end users all over the world.
 Based in France and present in Europe, USA, Asia and Africa, STREAMWIDE is listed on Euronext Growth (Paris) – ALSTW FR.
 For more information you can visit our LinkedIn and Twitter pages STREAMWIDE.
 We are currently looking for a Telecom Software Quality Assurance Automation to join our team. 
 Who you are 
Software Dev Engineer in Tests for Web Applications
Good knowledge of how web JavaScript, HTML 5 and CSS 3 applications are working
Good knowledge of Selenium framework
Good skill in writing Java code for our end-to-end automated tests
5+ years of experience in a similar position
Experience debugging Java applications, and understanding errors returned by the browser for CSS, and JavaScript applications
Knowledge working with Git
Person with initiative and ability to work as part of a team
Experience with developing tests for end to end third party integrations
Experience in working with Telecom Protocols or Mission Critical Products
Experience in working with Agile methodology, Jira.
Knowledge of HLD for applications
Managed at least one project/team of QA automation Engineers
Good level in spoken and written English
 Any or more of the following skills will be highly appreciated 
Large scale projects Product development lifecycle
CI/CD, end-to-end automation
Jenkins experience
 Key Responsibilities 
You will write tests for STREAMWIDE's Smart Messaging product and create test execution plans
You will help debugging the issues together with the product developers
You will update the automated testing pipelines/scripts to become more flexible and to run on any of the following Dev Servers, Staging Servers, and on developers’ computers
You will contribute with ideas for improving tests, testing framework and tests reporting system
 What we offer 
International work environment in an exciting growth phase
Friendly team
Attractive compensation package
Bookster subscription
Private medical subscription for you and family
